speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the emergency department. I need to assess your condition immediately; can you tell me exactly when your aggressive behavior and confusion started, and are you currently taking any prescription or over-the-counter medications?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Serotonin Syndrome.

The history of exam-induced agitation following extreme physical activity (breaking the computer, gym session) combined with altered mental status and autonomic dysregulation is highly suggestive of a serotonergic crisis. I need to confirm recent medication use and check vital signs immediately. REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel, CBC, EKG, Urine_Drug_Screen; REQUEST IMAGES: None needed at this stage.
